data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 140.2m (2016: GBP 102.4m) is a deterioration of GBP 19.1m (2016: deterioration of GBP 2.8m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Professional Lines and Energy with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Strengthening of reserves on legacy lines on 2013 & Prior, following late reporting developments, led to a deterioration of GBP 9.3m.

prior_year_events.event_name: 2015 Year of Account reinsured to close into 2016
prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2015 year of account reinsured to close into the 2016 year of account at 31 December 2017 at a loss of GBP 19.4m which will be called in June 2018.

named_events.event_name: Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and Mexico earthquakes
named_events.loss_description: Gross incurred losses of GBP 24.1m to the Property account; reinsurance programme significantly mitigated the impact on a net basis. Cargo, Marine Excess of Loss and Proportional Treaty classes had gross losses of GBP 11.7m.
A number of new significant losses were reported notably in relation to Californian utility business affecting the Non-Marine Liability account.

named_events.event_name: Pension mis-selling and case reserve developments (Professional Lines)
named_events.loss_description: Issues regarding pension mis-selling and material development on specific case reserves impacted the Professional Lines class driving a loss of GBP 1.8m for the year before administrative expenses.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 324.16m at 1 January 2017. The syndicate recorded adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 36.6m gross (11.3% of opening reserves), driven principally by adverse development on Professional Lines and Energy and by late reporting on legacy years (2013 & prior). The claims development triangle supports a gross strengthening. Separately, 2017 catastrophe events (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria and Mexico earthquakes) produced material gross losses, largely mitigated by reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration of GBP 19.1m (2016: deterioration of GBP 2.8m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Professional Lines and Energy with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.
Strengthening of reserves on legacy lines on 2013 & Prior, following late reporting developments, led to a deterioration of GBP 9.3m.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to Property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (note 21) by comparing current estimates to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2015 and earlier and summing the changes (result +36.585m gross). The report also states a net deterioration of GBP 19.1m in the income statement narrative; that figure is net of reinsurance and therefore not used for the gross PYD field. The triangle numbers were presented in GBP '000 and have been converted to millions. RITC/reinsurance movements (e.g. 2015 YOA reinsured to close into 2016 at a loss of GBP 19.4m) are separately disclosed and may affect comparability.
